**Question:** Who is Apple's CEO right now, when did the change take effect, and what is Tim Cook's current role?
*As of 2026-10-01*

- John Ternus is Apple's chief executive officer as of today, October 1, 2026. [1][2][3]
- The CEO change took effect on September 1, 2026. [4][1][3]
- Tim Cook's current role is Executive Chairman of Apple's board of directors. [5][1][2]
- Apple announced the succession in April 2026, with the board making the appointment on April 17, 2026 and announcing it on April 20, 2026. [1][3]
- Tim Cook's mandate as Executive Chairman includes engaging with policymakers around the world. [3][6]
- As of Apple's Q3 FY2026 earnings release dated July 30, 2026, Tim Cook was still identified as Apple's CEO, before the September 1, 2026 transition. [7]
- John Ternus joined Apple's board of directors on the same date the CEO change took effect, and Arthur Levinson moved from non-executive chairman to lead independent director. [1][3]

**Sources**
[1] Apple's New Leadership Structure: John Ternus Is CEO, Tim Cook Is Executive Chairman (www.macobserver.com, 2026-09-13, secondary) https://www.macobserver.com/news/apple-new-ceo-ternus-cook-executive-chairman
[2] Who is Apple’s new CEO? What to know before Sept. 9 event (www.usatoday.com, 2026-09-01, secondary) https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/2026/09/01/apple-new-ceo-john-ternus-background/91559585007
[3] The One Job Apple Wrote Down for Tim Cook — dvdmaru (dvdmaru.com, 2026-09-08, secondary) https://dvdmaru.com/articles/apple-ternus-handover-2026-en
[4] John Ternus | Incoming Apple CEO & Hardware Engineering Executive | Britannica Money (www.britannica.com, 2026-06-25, secondary) https://www.britannica.com/money/John-Ternus
[5] Tim Cook Ends Apple CEO Role as John Ternus Takes Over | Hypebeast (hypebeast.com, 2026-09-04, secondary) https://hypebeast.com/2026/9/tim-cook-ends-apple-ceo-era-as-john-ternus-rises
[6] Tim Cook signs off as Apple CEO, says ‘excited for the next chapter’ - The Economic Times (m.economictimes.com, 2026-08-31, secondary) https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/business/tim-cook-signs-off-as-apple-ceo-says-excited-for-the-next-chapter/articleshow/133658821.cms
